title: Nginx
description: Nginx traffic, errors, response time and clients from the access log (JSON to journald, shipped to VictoriaLogs), plus connection counters of nginx-prometheus-exporter.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Nodes that ship nginx access logs (journald _HOSTNAME); matches the instance label of the exporter metrics.

list.name: search
list.label: Filter
list.description: Extra LogsQL filter over the access log fields, e.g. status:502, path:"/login", user_agent:~"bot" or client_net:="198.51.100.0/24"

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Average request rate over the selected range.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats rate() rps

panels.title: 4xx
panels.description: Share of client errors (4xx) among all requests.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats count() if (status:4*) e, count() t | math e/t*100 as pct | delete e, t

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Share of server errors (5xx) among all requests.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats count() if (status:5*) e, count() t | math e/t*100 as pct | delete e, t

panels.title: p95 response time
panels.description: 95th percentile of request_time: from the first byte read from the client to the last byte sent.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats quantile(0.95, request_time) p95

panels.title: Rate limited
panels.description: Requests rejected with 429 (limit_req_status 429 / limit_conn_status 429).

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats count() if (status:=429) n

panels.title: Client networks
panels.description: Distinct client networks (/24 IPv4, /64 IPv6). Needs the opt-in client_net field of the nginx log format (see HOWTO); empty without it.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | filter client_net:* | stats count_uniq(client_net) nets

panels.title: Requests/s by domain
panels.description: Request rate per domain (nginx server_name, so random Host headers of an attack do not explode the legend).

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats by (server) rate() rps

panels.title: Responses/s by status
panels.description: Response rate per HTTP status code.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats by (status) rate() rps

panels.title: Domains
panels.description: Every domain over the selected range. Click a domain to narrow the dashboard to it.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats by (server) count() requests, rate() rps, count() if (status:4*) e4, count() if (status:5*) e5, quantile(0.95, request_time) p95, sum(bytes_sent) bytes | math e4/requests*100 as pct4, e5/requests*100 as pct5 | sort by (requests desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Traffic sent by domain
panels.description: Response body bytes sent per second.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats by (server) rate_sum(bytes_sent) bps

panels.title: Top paths
panels.description: Most requested paths (without the query string, which is never logged).

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats by (server, path) count() requests, quantile(0.95, request_time) p95 | sort by (requests desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of 4xx and 5xx responses.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats count() if (status:4*) e4, count() if (status:5*) e5, count() t | math e4/t*100 as "4xx", e5/t*100 as "5xx" | delete e4, e5, t

panels.title: Backend errors by upstream
panels.description: 5xx answers of upstreams (upstream_status), per upstream address. Separates a failing backend from errors nginx produces itself.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | filter upstream_status:~"5[0-9][0-9]" | stats by (upstream, upstream_status) rate() rps

panels.title: Top errors
panels.description: Most frequent error responses (status >= 400). 499: the client closed the connection before the answer; 502/504: the upstream failed or timed out; 429: rate limited.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | filter status:>=400 | stats by (server, method, path, status) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 25

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: Percentiles of request_time over all requests.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats quantile(0.5, request_time) p50, quantile(0.95, request_time) p95, quantile(0.99, request_time) p99

panels.title: p95 response time by domain
panels.description: 95th percentile of request_time per domain.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats by (server) quantile(0.95, request_time) p95

panels.title: p95 upstream response time
panels.description: 95th percentile of upstream_response_time per upstream address: how long the backend itself took.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | filter upstream:* | stats by (upstream) quantile(0.95, upstream_response_time) p95

panels.title: Slowest paths
panels.description: Paths with the highest p95 response time (at least 10 requests in range).

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | stats by (server, path) count() requests, quantile(0.95, request_time) p95, max(request_time) max | filter requests:>=10 | sort by (p95 desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Top client networks
panels.description: Networks sending the most requests; during an attack they are the candidates for blocking. Click a network to filter the logs and panels by it. Needs the opt-in client_net field of the nginx log format (see HOWTO); empty without it.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | filter client_net:* | stats by (client_net) count() requests, count() if (status:>=400) errors, count() if (status:=429) limited, count_uniq(path) paths | sort by (requests desc) | limit 20

panels.title: Requests/s of top client networks
panels.description: Request rate of the 5 busiest client networks of the range. Needs the opt-in client_net field of the nginx log format (see HOWTO); empty without it.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | filter client_net:in(SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | filter client_net:* | top 5 by (client_net) | fields client_net) | stats by (client_net) rate() rps

panels.title: Top user agents
panels.description: Most frequent User-Agent headers.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | top 10 by (user_agent)

panels.title: Top referrers
panels.description: Sites that link to these domains (host of the Referer header only).

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | filter referer_host:* | top 10 by (referer_host)

panels.title: Nginx status
panels.description: nginx_up of nginx-prometheus-exporter per node.

targets.expr: nginx_up{instance=~"$node"}

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Client connections by state (stub_status).

targets.expr: nginx_connections_active{instance=~"$node"}
nginx_connections_reading{instance=~"$node"}
nginx_connections_writing{instance=~"$node"}
nginx_connections_waiting{instance=~"$node"}

panels.title: Accepted / dropped connections
panels.description: Rate of accepted connections and of connections nginx dropped (accepted minus handled: worker_connections or another resource limit was reached).

targets.expr: rate(nginx_connections_accepted{instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])
rate(nginx_connections_accepted{instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]) - rate(nginx_connections_handled{instance=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])

panels.title: Access log
panels.description: Requests, newest first: status, method, Host header + path, request time. Expand a line for all fields.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_access _HOSTNAME:$node | unpack_json fields (server, host, method, path, protocol, status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, referer_host, user_agent, client_net) | filter server:$domain $search | format "<status> <method> <host><path> <request_time>s" as _msg

panels.title: Error log
panels.description: nginx error log: failed upstream connections, limit_req rejections and the like. Opt-in (see HOWTO): nginx writes the full client address into these lines, so it is off by default. The Filter variable does not apply here.

targets.expr: SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER:=nginx_error _HOSTNAME:$node
